name: Burundi

fees.name: Entry visa (simple entry, online via migration.gov.bi)
fees.notes: Applied online on the official CGM portal; same fee schedule as visas obtained at embassies or on arrival.

fees.name: Entry visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: Obtainable online, at the airport, or through Burundian embassies.

fees.name: Airport entry visa (visa d'entree aeroport)
fees.notes: CGM portal lists 'Visa d'entree aeroport' as a service; entry-visa tariff is USD 90 per the official fee table. Pre-application online is encouraged.

fees.name: Business travel (uses standard entry visa)
fees.notes: Burundi does not publish a separate business-visa category; business travellers use the standard simple/multiple entry visa (USD 90). Stay extension: USD 10 per 5 days (max 25 days), then USD 70 per month.

reciprocity_variations.note: East African Community citizens: free EAC visa/pass valid 6 months per official CGM tariff table.

free_visa_notes: Visas are not free generally; EAC member-state citizens receive a free 6-month EAC entry pass and free student visas.
